claims: A settlement has a family of price-parameterized value homomorphisms `V p s = p * dx + dy`.
Conservation is exactly value at unit price.
Balanced settlement value decomposes to price deviation times token-X exposure.
Two distinct price evaluations determine a settlement uniquely.
LP valuation is a price-indexed homomorphism over reserve components.
LP value sensitivity is exactly reserve-X exposure.
LP valuation is faithful: equal value at every price implies equal reserves.
LP swap value and trader PnL are zero-sum under the stated value model.

boundaries: These proofs define a value algebra and separation theory; they do not choose live market prices.
